description: Remove an application from the tracker, for example a duplicate or a mistaken entry. Inputs: id of the application (from add_application or list_applications). The application is deleted from the local file and cannot be brought back, and the ids of the other applications do not change. Example prompt: "Delete application 3, it was a duplicate."

id.description: The id of the application to delete.

name: delete_application

added.description: The day it was added, YYYY-MM-DD.

deadline.description: Last day to apply as YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

interview_date.description: Interview date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or null.

source.description: Where you found the posting, or null.

status.description: The stage the application is in.

updated.description: The day it last changed, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: Delete application
